title: Fix uploaded video not appearing on feed

requirements.text: After a successful video upload via the Upload page, the newly created video must appear in the main feed (Feed.tsx) without requiring a manual page refresh. Ensure the feed query cache is invalidated or refetched after the createVideo mutation completes successfully.

quotes: I uploaded it and it didn't show up on the feed

acceptanceCriteria: After uploading a video and being navigated to the feed, the newly uploaded video is visible in the feed list.
The feed React Query cache is invalidated on successful createVideo mutation completion.
No manual page refresh is required for the new video to appear.

requirements.text: Verify that the backend `createVideo` function correctly persists the uploaded video to stable storage and returns it in the `getVideos` (or equivalent feed-fetch) query. If the video is not being stored or returned by the backend feed query, fix the persistence or retrieval logic in backend/main.mo.

quotes: I uploaded it and it didn't show up on the feed

acceptanceCriteria: A video created via createVideo is retrievable by the feed query (e.g., getVideos) immediately after creation.
The backend stores the video in stable state so it persists across calls.
The feed query returns the newly uploaded video in the response list.

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
nonGoals: Adding new video fields or metadata beyond what already exists.
